tweets: Missing access controls let malicious actors withdraw Ether from contract accounts.
Unprotected withdrawal bugs sometimes stem from unintentionally exposing initialization functions.
In legacy Solidity <0.4.22, misnaming a constructor places code in runtime bytecode for anyone to call.
Implement access controls so only authorized parties can initiate withdrawals per contract requirements.
Inheriting OpenZeppelin Ownable provides an onlyOwner modifier to restrict function execution.
